t: The JSP Sonis 1 Mounted Ear Defenders offer reliable low attenuation hearing protection with a 26dB Standard Noise Reduction (SNR), crucial for trade professionals in noisy environments. Constructed from durable ABS plastic, these ear defenders are built to last. They are ideal for use in workshops, printing works, and landscaping, providing effective sound dampening, and a non-conductive design adds safety in areas with electrical hazards. The adjustable height and angle, alongside a tilt and adjust earcup position, ensure a comfortable and secure fit for extended periods. Designed to be compatible with JSP safety helmets and EVOguard visors (sold separately), they integrate seamlessly into existing JSP head protection setups. Designed with a traffic light colour code for easy identification.
b: Lightweight & Comfortable Design With Soft-Cushioned Ear Seals
